{icon:bullet,1.2} Using an {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skill resets {c_important}Concealment's{/c} Cooldown. 
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}Concealment{/c} gains all Upgrades for free and also grants {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%|]{/c} Damage Reduction while active and then {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"|%|]{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} seconds after.
